_doc: sanity_plan.py: entries in order (the same idea as MAA GUI's 库存保持 / DepotMaintain, ported to maa-cli). An entry applies when its time window (until), game-day weekdays and need all hold. An entry with need {item, count_as, target} becomes a Fight task with drops = {item: target - stock} (MaaCore stops when that many dropped) and the next entry still runs; an entry without need spends the rest of the sanity and ends the list. count_as weights other items into the stock, e.g. a dual chip = 2 chip packs (MAA: 芯片组计入双芯片折算). Stock: last Skland export. Stage open days: arknights/GAME_NOTES.md. Orders behind the needs: arknights/goals.json.
